headline: OpenAI and Microsoft knew they were starting a ‘doom loop’ for the web
summary: Unsealed court documents reveal OpenAI and Microsoft internally warned of web damage. Companies' own documentation referred to a potential "doom loop." They also characterized data scraping as potentially the "largest theft of labor in human history."

headline: Virginia governor creates an AI task force and moves to restrain data centers
summary: Virginia Gov. Abigail Spanberger established an AI task force. An executive order aims to empower local communities regarding data center development. The move could slow approvals in Virginia, a global data center hub.

headline: Disney’s first CTO is Character.AI’s former CEO
summary: Disney has appointed its very first Chief Technology Officer (CTO). Karandeep Anand, formerly CEO of Character.AI, takes on the new role. Anand will report directly to Disney's current CEO.

headline: The real story of the iPhone 18 Pro’s camera
summary: The iPhone 18 Pro features significant camera upgrades this year. A key innovation is the new variable aperture main lens. This lens improves low-light performance and offers better depth of field control.

headline: Marvel's Wolverine Developer Nerfs Scent Trails and Audio Sense Indicators After 'Fart Gas' Backlash
summary: Insomniac has updated Marvel's Wolverine to nerf specific in-game features. Scent trails, dubbed "fart gas," drew significant community backlash. Audio sense indicators were also adjusted in the new patch.

headline: Lollipop Chainsaw Live-Action Movie Revealed by Dragami Games
summary: A live-action Lollipop Chainsaw movie is officially in development. Developer Dragami Games made the announcement. This marks a new adaptation for the cult classic game.

headline: Resident Evil Fans 'Will Feel Seen' After the Movie, Says Director Zach Cregger
summary: Resident Evil director Zach Cregger promises fans will feel acknowledged by the new movie. Cregger discussed reviving the horror franchise with star Austin Abrams. The director aims to please long-time fans of the beloved series.

headline: We Ranked the 10 Best First Partner Pokémon TCG Cards of All Time
summary: A list ranking the top 10 First Partner Pokémon TCG cards has been published. The ranking includes valuable cards like $4,500 vintage grails. Iconic Charizard classics and budget-friendly options also made the cut.

headline: US and Denmark reach deal over Greenland after Trump annexation threats
summary: The US and Denmark have finalized an agreement regarding Greenland. The deal follows former President Trump's past suggestions of annexing the territory. Trump claims the agreement grants the US "permanent control over security" in Greenland.

headline: 'I'm telling the truth': Earl Spencer defends Diana book claims about Charles in BBC interview
summary: Earl Spencer defended his claims about Prince Charles in his new book about Princess Diana. He confirmed Charles used the exact phrase "we'll forget her soon enough." Spencer reiterated the accuracy of his account during a BBC interview.

headline: Watch: Diana's brother says Charles 'went ballistic' in phone call after her death
summary: Earl Spencer shared details of a heated phone call with Prince Charles after Diana's death. He stated that Charles "went ballistic" during the conversation. Spencer revealed these claims in an exclusive BBC interview.

headline: Billionaire Man United owner says he has lost confidence in the UK
summary: Sir Jim Ratcliffe, owner of Manchester United, expressed a loss of confidence in the UK. He described the country as being "on the slide." Ratcliffe called for increased investment, particularly in the North Sea.
